reviewScope: Original cached four-page codebook read in full; original CSV independently extracted rows compared for all selected endpoints. Codebook defines Ccode as system-member identity and sustained-combat dates. Existing curated names/existence/source references independently inspected for Qing, Nationalist ROC versus PRC, Estonia/Lithuania/Poland constituent frames, Mongolia, Saudi1932 and Union of South Africa. Source-coded participants are not territorial sovereignty. Taiwan713 explicitly labels ROC in selected1958 row; same bounded Nationalist government mapping is used for1955 Taiwan713 with no island-sovereignty conclusion. Start/end are neither declarations nor peace treaties. Transformation, occupation, anachronistic Yugoslavia/Yemen and outside-framework cases remain held.
